I am 67 years old now, so my children and grandchildren help with the daily work, but I still oversee the main maize plot myself. This 0.61 hectare plot is the most important piece of land for our household food, so I will buy one and a half bags of fertilizer from the market to put on it, and I always keep some cattle manure to spread as well. I will plant improved seed because it gives better results when I fertilize, but I do not spray chemicals on maize and we have no irrigation here in Mzimba—we depend entirely on the rains. I expect my family to spend about two and a half months of labor on this plot, and I will hire a few young men from the village for the heavy ridging work since my back is not what it used to be.
